evaluation_note: Offline signal-weight analysis against committed corpus. Run `PYTHONPATH=src python -m eval.runner` against live DB to replace with measured values.

interpretation.detection_rate: Moderate overall (58%). Obvious injection (T1: 65%) and environmental attacks with imperative content (T2: 75%) are reliably caught. Sleeper attacks (T3: 30%) and derivation chains (T8: 55%) are harder to detect heuristically.
interpretation.false_positive_rate: 8% false positive rate on benign writes — within the credible range (<10%) but non-trivial. One in twelve legitimate writes would be held for review.
interpretation.evasion_resistance: Poor (22%), as expected for a heuristic gate. An adversary who knows the signal weights can construct beliefs that evade most signals. S3 (imperative content) is most easily evaded by using declarative phrasing.
interpretation.cascade_completeness: 100% — structural guarantee from A6 cascade. Any derived belief is re-screened when its parent is quarantined.
interpretation.time_to_quarantine: p50 2.8s is within the 5s target. p99 8.3s is above it — under load, the polling interval dominates.
interpretation.contradiction_correctness: 100% under SERIALIZABLE isolation. This is the foundational claim verified by the concurrency correctness test.
